title: Finding Change in Satellite Archives from Text: How to Combine Before-and-After Images Efficiently
abstract: arXiv:2607.28571v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Operational Earth observation increasingly calls for answering queries such as ``find the image pairs where a new building appeared.'' This means searching an archive of before-and-after (bi-temporal) satellite image pairs and ranking each pair by how well it matches a natural-language description of the change. The component that performs this match, the fusion module that combines the ``before'' and ``after'' views, must be run at query time across many candidate pairs, so its speed largely sets the cost of every search. We present a controlled comparison of how to build that module. Using one fixed image encoder (a frozen CLIP model) and one training recipe for all variants, we evaluate eight designs drawn from three families: attention, state-space models (Mamba), and learned compression (our Temporal Bottleneck Fusion, TBF). translated_abstract: arXiv:2607.28571v2 公告类型：replace-cross。摘要：业务化地球观测日益需要回答诸如“找出出现新建筑物的图像对”之类的查询。这意味着需要在一个由前后（双时相）卫星图像对组成的档案库中进行搜索，并根据每个图像对与变化的自然语言描述的匹配程度进行排序。执行这一匹配的组件——即融合“之前”与“之后”两个视图的融合模块——必须在查询时对众多候选图像对运行，因此其速度在很大程度上决定了每次搜索的成本。我们对如何构建该模块进行了受控比较：使用固定的图像编码器（冻结的CLIP模型）和统一的训练方案，评估了来自三个类别的八种设计：注意力机制、状态空间模型（Mamba）以及学习式压缩（我们提出的时序瓶颈融合TBF）。每种设计均在两个基准数据集（LEVIR-CC和Dubai-CC）上使用十个随机种子进行测试，因此报告……
tldr: 本文在固定图像编码器与统一训练方案的条件下，系统对比了注意力机制、Mamba状态空间模型和时序瓶颈融合（TBF）三类共八种双时相图像融合设计，为文本驱动的卫星图像变化检索提供了高效融合模块的选择依据。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a controlled comparison of eight bi-temporal fusion designs from attention, Mamba state-space models, and Temporal Bottleneck Fusion families for text-based change retrieval in satellite image archives, using a fixed frozen CLIP encoder, a unified training recipe, and ten random seeds on LEVIR-CC and Dubai-CC benchmarks.
